patterns: APPSC asks direct recall: zone HQ (West Central = Jabalpur, SECR = Bilaspur), first railway 1853 Bombay-Thane, first crude pipeline Naharkatia-Nunmati-Barauni.
Highway corridor facts recur across PSCs: E-W = Silchar-Porbandar, N-S/E-W junction = Jhansi, GQ joins Delhi-Mumbai-Chennai-Kolkata, longest NH (old NH-7, now NH-44).
Current-affairs flavour in APPSC: Mission 41K, electrification % (COREs 94% on 1 Mar 2024), DigiYatra airports, GAIL pipelines in AP.
Traps: Konkan Railway is a PSU not a zone; HBJ is gas (GAIL), Hazira in Gujarat; Hyderabad not on GQ.
App MCQs over-rely on 2026 budget/GM/route-km statistics in multi-statement form; APPSC prefers one-line zone/route/first questions.
